Internal helper: hand a stored filter's fault back to the status display

Source: R/pipeline-internals.R
dot-jst_filter_status_signal.Rd

The status displays (jsubset() with no arguments) run each stored filter through .jst_filter_mask(origin = "status") to say whether it can still be applied. A status display must not stop, so where the analysis-time origin would call .jst_stop() this signals a condition of class jst_filter_unusable whose message is the status line – "It cannot be applied: keep12 no longer exists." – and the display catches exactly that class. Never reaches the user as an error.

Usage

.jst_filter_status_signal(text)

Arguments

text

Character. The status line.

Value

Does not return.
